question: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya Participates in Seminar on Health Challenges and Healthy Lifestyle at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, ______________________.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Faridabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya Participates in Seminar on Health Challenges and Healthy Lifestyle at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya**, the **Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports**, participated in a seminar on **"Health Challenges and Healthy Lifestyle"** organized by **Arogya Bharti** in collaboration with **ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad**.
 
• The seminar took place in **Faridabad, Haryana**, and saw the active participation of **doctors, paramedics, medical students, industrial workers**, and **office bearers of industrial associations**, highlighting a collective focus on **preventive healthcare** and **holistic well-being**.
 
• During the seminar, advanced medical facilities such as **Digital Mammography, Digital Radiography Fluoroscopy System**, and **Next-Generation Sequencing Application** were inaugurated.
 
• A **Statue of Lord Dhanwantari** was unveiled at the **ESIC Medical College & Hospital premises** to honor the significance of healthcare and wellness.
